entities.name: Fomori-Eldrazi war
entities.description: Millennia-old conflict in the Edge in which the Fomori and Drix drove the Eldrazi out.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Fought the Eldrazi and then disappeared from the Edge.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: Fought the Eldrazi and remain Eldrazi hunters.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Devourers forced out of the Edge.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: Passage through which Eldrazi made an incursion.

entities.name: Vaar
entities.description: Nearly eradicated; fled into the Hylderhigh.

entities.name: Hylderhigh
entities.description: Virtual world the Vaar fled to.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Saw Eldrazi horrors in Jadzi's mind.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: Oracle whose mind Jace accessed as she died.

events.summary: The Fomori and Drix fight the Eldrazi incursion through the Chaos Wall and force them out of the Edge.
events.quote: The Fomori were successful, with the Eldrazi being forced out of the Edge.

events.summary: The Fomori disappear while the Drix become Eldrazi hunters.
events.quote: the Fomori disappeared from the Edge in the aftermath of the conflict

events.summary: Jace Beleren sees Eldrazi horrors in Jadzi's mind as she dies and travels back in time.
events.quote: formless Eldrazi horrors snaking around the great ships battling them

events.summary: The Vaar are nearly eradicated and flee into the Hylderhigh.
events.quote: They fled from the Eldrazi into a virtual world, the Hylderhigh

relations.quote: the Fomori and the Drix fought an incursion of the Eldrazi
the Drix have remained consummate Eldrazi hunters
